title: Office
description: Desks, screens and a lot of coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, I'm new here. Is this going to be my desk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, welcome aboard! IT has already set up your monitor and keyboard.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's great. Where's the nearest printer, by the way?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's in the corner, right next to the water dispenser.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And is there somewhere I can make coffee?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The kitchen's down the hall. Bring your own mug, though. The office ones always go missing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Shall we tidy up a bit before we head home?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. I'll take a photo of the whiteboard and then erase it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. I'll put these folders back in the filing cabinet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Could you also water the plant? It's looking a bit droopy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Will do. And you should finally take your mug home this weekend.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fine, fine. I'll wash it first, I promise.

selfTalk.text: The whiteboard is still covered with diagrams from yesterday's meeting that nobody bothered to erase.
Before the team comes in, I'll take a photo of the whiteboard and then wipe it clean.
It drives me crazy when every marker next to the whiteboard has already run out of ink.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it okay if I wipe the whiteboard? I need it for a quick brainstorm.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hang on, let me take a picture first. That's the project timeline we spent an hour on.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, good thing I asked. I almost erased the whole thing.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go ahead now. Just leave the deadlines in the corner of the board, if you can.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No problem, I'll work around them.

selfTalk.text: From the window next to my desk, I can see the coffee shop across the street getting busy.
It's so stuffy in here that I'm going to open the window for ten minutes.
Ever since I moved closer to the window, I've felt a lot less tired in the afternoons.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Would you mind if I opened the window? It's getting really stuffy in here.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not at all. I was just about to ask the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let me know if it gets too cold or windy for you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I will. Just remember to close the window before you leave, or the cleaners will complain.

selfTalk.text: The grey filing cabinet in the corner has three drawers, and the top one has been locked for weeks.
I need to put these signed contracts in the filing cabinet before I forget where I left them.
Honestly, I'm a little afraid of what I'll find if I ever clean out the bottom drawer of that cabinet.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you know where we keep last year's invoices?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They should be in the filing cabinet, second drawer from the top.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I just tried it, but the cabinet seems to be locked.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ah, Sam has the key. He usually keeps it on his keychain.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll ask him when he gets back from lunch.

selfTalk.text: The potted plant next to the filing cabinet is the only thing in this office that's actually thriving.
Since nobody else ever remembers, I'll water the plant on my way out this evening.
Having a plant nearby makes the office feel a lot less like a dentist's waiting room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Who's been looking after this plant? It looks so much healthier than last month.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's Mia. She waters it every Friday and turns it toward the window.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I wish I had her skills. Every plant I've owned has died within a few weeks.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She says the secret is not to water it too often.

selfTalk.text: My desk is so cluttered with paperwork that I can barely find space for my laptop.
Let me clear off my desk before the meeting so I don't look completely disorganized.
I'd probably be more productive if my desk were next to the window instead of the hallway.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is anyone sitting at this desk today, or is it free?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's free. We switched to hot-desking last month, so nobody has an assigned desk anymore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I didn't know that. Do I need to book it somewhere?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Normally you'd use the app, but for today just write your name on the sheet by the door.

selfTalk.text: There's a fingerprint right in the middle of my monitor, and now I can't stop noticing it.
I'll tilt the monitor down a little and lower the brightness, because my eyes are getting tired.
If I had a second monitor, I wouldn't have to keep switching between all these spreadsheets.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My monitor suddenly went black in the middle of a call.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Have you checked whether the cable at the back has come loose?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, you're right. It was hanging out. The screen's working again.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That happens to me all the time. Someone keeps kicking the cables under the desk.

selfTalk.text: Someone has stuck a yellow sticky note on the corner of my monitor with a phone number on it.
I'll jot the meeting time down on a sticky note so I don't double-book myself again.
My desk is covered in so many sticky notes that I can't tell which ones still matter.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you know who left this sticky note on my screen?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That was me. Your client called while you were in the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. Did they say what it was about?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not really, but they left a number. It's on the back of the note.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Got it. I'll call them back right after lunch.

selfTalk.text: A few keys on my keyboard have started sticking, probably because of all the crumbs underneath them.
During my break, I'm going to turn my keyboard upside down and shake out the crumbs.
My new keyboard is so loud that I'm worried it's distracting everyone around me.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is that your keyboard making all that clicking? It sounds like rain on a roof.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sorry, it's a mechanical one. I got it because it's easier on my wrists.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No worries, I'm just curious. Is it really that much better to type on?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: For me, yes. Try my keyboard after lunch if you like, and see what you think.

selfTalk.text: My wireless mouse is sitting right next to the keyboard, but its battery light has started flashing.
I'd better charge my mouse during lunch, or it'll die in the middle of my presentation.
This mouse is way too small for my hand, so my wrist starts aching by the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My cursor keeps freezing, and I can't figure out why.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Have you tried changing the batteries in your mouse?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not yet. Do we have any spare batteries around here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There's a box in the supply cabinet next to the printer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll grab a couple and see if that fixes it.

selfTalk.text: My headset is lying next to the keyboard, still tangled up from yesterday's back-to-back calls.
Let me put on my headset and test the mic, because the call starts in two minutes.
After wearing this headset all day, my ears feel sore and a little squashed.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you hear me okay? I feel like I'm shouting.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You sound pretty quiet, actually. Is your headset plugged in?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oops, I've been using the laptop mic this whole time. How about now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Much better. I can hear you loud and clear.

selfTalk.text: My mug still has some cold coffee at the bottom from this morning that I completely forgot about.
I'm going to rinse out my mug and make a fresh cup of tea before the next meeting.
I always leave my mug on my desk over the weekend and feel guilty about it on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this your mug in the sink? It's been there since Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh no, sorry! I meant to wash it and totally forgot.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No worries. It's a really cute mug, by the way.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! My niece painted it for my birthday, so I should probably take better care of it.

selfTalk.text: The red stapler on the corner of my desk is the only one in the office that still works properly.
Before I hand in the report, I'd better staple the pages together so none of them get lost.
If this stapler jams one more time, I'm going to ask the office manager to order a new one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sorry to bother you, but could I borrow your stapler for a sec?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, it's in the top drawer. Just be careful, it's been jamming lately.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. Mine ran out of staples halfway through the handouts.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: There should be a fresh box in the supply cabinet if you need a refill.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'll grab one and bring yours right back.

selfTalk.text: My swivel chair squeaks every time I lean back, which is pretty embarrassing in quiet meetings.
I should raise my chair a little so I'm not hunching over the keyboard all day.
When I'm stuck on a problem, I sometimes spin around in my chair until an idea comes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mind if I borrow your chair for the meeting? There aren't enough in the conference room.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, just roll it back when you're done.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. Mine has a broken wheel, so it keeps tipping to one side.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You should report that chair to the office manager before someone falls off it.

selfTalk.text: The water dispenser by the window has a red tap for hot water and a blue one for cold.
I'm going to fill up my bottle at the water dispenser so I don't have to keep getting up.
I really should visit the water dispenser more often, since I've only had one cup today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is the water dispenser empty again? Nothing's coming out.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Looks like it. The bottle needs changing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Should I call someone from facilities?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No need, I can do it myself. It's pretty heavy, though.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here, I'll help you lift it onto the dispenser.

selfTalk.text: The printer in the corner is so old and noisy that you can hear it from the other side of the office.
I need to print out the report and pick it up before anyone else takes it by mistake.
Whenever I'm in a hurry, the printer seems to run out of paper or jam on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is the printer working? My document hasn't come out yet.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's showing a paper jam error again.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ugh. Do you know how to fix it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Open the side panel and slowly pull out the stuck paper. Don't yank it, or it'll tear.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Got it. Thanks, you're a lifesaver.
